name: OmaWarden
author: Salem Sayed
description: Bitwarden in the Omarchy bar: instant search, safe timed copies, lock and sync.

barWidget.description: Search your Bitwarden logins, copy passwords, usernames and one-time codes to a self-clearing clipboard, lock and sync.

schema.label: Status check (seconds)
schema.description: How often the bar re-reads the local vault state. Never contacts the server.

schema.label: Lock after inactivity
schema.description: Lock the vault after it goes unused for the inactivity delay.

schema.label: Inactivity delay (minutes)
schema.description: How long the vault may sit unused before it locks.

schema.label: Clipboard timeout (seconds)
schema.description: How long a copied secret stays on the clipboard. It never enters Omarchy's clipboard history.

schema.label: Results shown
schema.description: How many logins to list at once.

schema.label: Sync after unlock
schema.description: Sync with the server each time you unlock.

schema.label: Lock when the screen locks
schema.description: Lock the vault when Omarchy's lock screen engages.

schema.label: Enter copies
schema.description: What Enter copies. Shift+Enter copies the other.

schema.label: Bitwarden CLI command
schema.description: A command name or full path, arguments allowed.

schema.label: Unlock prompt
schema.description: Pinentry keeps the master password in a separate process. Native is a themed prompt drawn by the shell.

schema.label: Pinentry command
schema.description: auto, or a Pinentry program. Used with the Pinentry unlock prompt.

schema.label: CLI profile folder
schema.description: A separate CLI data folder, for keeping a second account apart.

schema.label: Server URL
schema.description: Self-hosted or EU server, applied when you sign in. Leave empty for bitwarden.com.
